visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair wearing a white button-up shirt and a lanyard stands behind a display table. The table is crowded with various colorful metal toolboxes (white, gray, green, red, black). He smiles and gestures enthusiastically towards the camera. The background features a large sign with 'TOYO STEEL CO.,LTD' and shelves of smaller metal storage boxes. (2) The man points upward toward the brand logo behind him, then uses both hands to showcase the array of toolboxes in front of him. His facial expressions are animated as he speaks directly to the camera. (3) The camera zooms in slightly as the man picks up and touches the different colored metal boxes, demonstrating their finish and build quality. The background lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional exhibition hall. (4) The man brings his hands together in a clasping gesture while continuing to talk. He maintains eye contact with the lens. The display area includes labels like 'CHUMS' and other collaborative brand logos on the wall. (5) The man points to various stacks of containers on lower shelves, showing the variety of products. The scene is brightly lit with overhead studio-style lights reflected in the glossy surfaces of the metal boxes.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: START!. [Subtitle]: OK 好各位朋友們大家好 我是 Alan. (2) [Subtitle]: 我現在人在東京國際展示館. (3) [Subtitle]: 今天是7月份的東京的禮品展 也算是個雜貨展. (4) [Subtitle]: 我現在人在TOYO STEEL 東洋鋼鐵的展示的攤位. (5) [Subtitle]: 然後跟大家介紹一下 TOYO STEEL 的產品. (6) [Subtitle]: TOYO STEEL 的這個產品是全部都是日本原裝的. (7) [Subtitle]: 而且是全世界第一個用一塊鋼板. (8) [Subtitle]: 壓制而成 中間都沒有任何的焊接點. (9) [Subtitle]: 所以品質非常優雅. (10) [Subtitle]: 整個噴漆製造全部都是在日本製造. (11) [Subtitle]: 我們是台灣的總代理商. (12) [Subtitle]: 今天非常開心他們原廠正在展覽. (13) [Subtitle]: 想說來這個地方介紹給大家. (14) [Subtitle]: 你看 他們很多的 這個都是聯名款式的. (15) [Subtitle]: 所以各位朋友們 如果你是個品牌商. (16) [Subtitle]: 我們也非常歡迎 可以直接跟我們公司. (17) [Subtitle]: 台灣這邊的代理商聯絡 龍欣興業有限公司. (18) [Subtitle]: 直接跟我們聯絡 我們也可以幫你做一些聯名款式的設計跟整合. (19) [Subtitle]: 當然如果你自己的設計師那會更好. (20) [Subtitle]: 那我們可以幫你做印刷. (21) [Subtitle]: 那這部分我們全部都可以幫你做. (22) [Subtitle]: 那現在目前台灣像誠品書店 還有線上通路PCHOME MOMO. (23) [Subtitle]: 這些所有的大型的中型的小型的店上(露營通路也有販售). (24) [Subtitle]: 全部都有在銷售這些產品. (25) [Subtitle]: 各位如果有興趣 你想看實體的產品的話. (26) [Subtitle]: 可以到我們的誠品書店那邊 現在連鎖店裡面有通路都有專櫃. (27) [Subtitle]: 請大家多多支持 TOYO STEEL. (28) [Subtitle]: 謝謝大家 再見.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Intro -> Quality Description -> Business Collaboration Offer -> Retail Availability -> Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a professional promotional vlog intended to showcase Toyo Steel's presence at the Tokyo Gift Show. The presenter, Alan (a distributor from Taiwan), emphasizes the high quality and seamless manufacturing of the Japanese-made metal toolboxes. The goal is to both attract potential brand collaborators for co-designed products and to inform Taiwanese consumers where they can purchase the items locally.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The presenter explicitly names the brand TOYO STEEL, wears a badge at their booth, and directly encourages viewers to support and purchase the products.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy social media format with constant subtitles and upbeat music to maintain viewer engagement while providing B2B and B2C marketing information.
